mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales over the past month indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed's policy shift dampens equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past three months signals weakening economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and federal funds rate signals dual economic stress from labor market deterioration and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in GDP growth as measured by GDPC1 predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions with declining GDPC1, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
